in_marathi.name: Parameswar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Parameswar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Parameswar is derived from Sanskrit, where Para means supreme and Ishwar means lord. This name signifies the ultimate deity, the supreme ruler of the universe.
